description: Edit a talking-head video in the PERSA style — a warm, desaturated, grain-and-bloom film grade over hard-cut one-word captions, with the subject matted back on top so the head occludes the big emphasis words and the floating media panels behind it. Real screen recordings as rounded panels and head cards; three accents (red / lime / amber); a hand-lettered note tier. Runs at 16:9 (the studio default) or 9:16 (the aspect it was measured in). Uses HyperFrames (HTML→MP4). This is the third house style alongside `nextphase-long-editing` (coral dotted grid) and `motiongraphics` (violet glow). In Video Studio the style comes from the studio job; never ask.
